intent: Path to the current page as a hierarchy of links.
useWhen: show where this page sits in the app
sit above PageHeader or in a list-detail chrome
doNotUseWhen: in-page sections — use Tabs or Section

onClick.note: In-app select. When set, the crumb is a button. Last item is still the current page and is never a control.

icon.note: Lucide name (e.g. House), Lucide component, or element, before the label. aria-hidden.

iconOnly.note: Show only icon (e.g. a Home house). label stays as visually hidden text (the link's accessible name) and the hover title. Needs icon.

items.note: Last item is the current page (no href used even if passed). Need at least 2 items.

maxItems.note: When items.length > maxItems, show the first item, an ellipsis, then the last (maxItems - 1) items. Ellipsis is aria-hidden, not interactive.

requirements: current page has aria-current="page" and is not a link
collapsed ellipsis is aria-hidden and not interactive
icon is aria-hidden; an iconOnly crumb keeps its label as visually hidden text and title, so the link is named

doNot: Do not invent local Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, or BreadcrumbLink
Do not turn the current page into a link
Do not put an unlabelled icon crumb (a bare house link) — use icon + iconOnly with label
Do not put a dropdown on the ellipsis (no DropdownMenu in the kit)
snippet: <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Home", href: "/" }, { label: "Components", href: "/components" }, { label: "Breadcrumb" }]} />
